svg.title: SpearSim campaign data boundaries
svg.desc: An admin console drives a FastAPI campaign API that pseudonymises employees and gates launch on recorded consent; an email pipeline sends only aliases and roles to Groq and real addresses to SendGrid; employees interact through public tracking endpoints that record event flags and quiz scores in Supabase Postgres, which a retention Edge Function purges after 90 days; four verified implementation limits are listed.
svg.text: CSV email must match org domain
alias, the CSV role and the
VERIFIED LIMITS · FOUND IN CODE, NOT STATED IN THE README
Launch checks consent_signed only. The authorisation-PDF download
is required by the browser wizard, not by the API.
name_map.real_name is a plain TEXT column. The Supabase Vault
encryption mentioned in comments is not set up in the repository.
The phish page posts to /api/track/cred, but the backend route is
/track/cred, so credential events may go unrecorded (static analysis).
RLS policies let the anon role SELECT every employees row,
including email addresses. The backend bypasses RLS entirely.
